invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2130（基于ATR 15.8588调整，上移止损以锁定部分风险），或融资费率Z-score回升至50%以上（空头风险缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 2062.29）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2130 (adjusted based on ATR 15.8588, moving stop up to lock in some risk), or funding Z-score rises above 50% (short risk eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 2062.29).
